vikunja.title: Vikunja
vikunja.description: Two-way sync with a self-hosted Vikunja project.

connect.title: Connect Vikunja
connect.description: Point the widget at your Vikunja instance and paste a personal API token.
connect.helpLinkLabel: Where do I get a token?
connect.helpText: In Vikunja: Settings → API tokens. Enter your instance URL above and this turns into a direct link.
connect.invalidUrl: That doesn't look like a valid address. Include the scheme, e.g. https://tasks.example.com.
connect.httpsOnly: Only https is supported — the token is sent with every request.
connect.permissionDenied: Chrome must be allowed to reach this host before the widget can sync. Nothing was saved; press Connect again and accept the prompt.
connect.versionWarning: Tested with Vikunja 2.6; other versions may behave differently.

board.title: Pick a project
board.description: Choose the project whose kanban view this widget will sync with.
board.empty: No projects with a kanban view on this account.

mapping.title: Map buckets to statuses
mapping.description: Each status can pull from multiple buckets. The first bucket in each row is where new tasks land.
mapping.suggestedHint: Buckets are pre-matched by name — check the rows and fix anything that looks off.
mapping.conflict: One bucket is mapped to two statuses. A task in it would have no single status — remove one of them.
mapping.terminalMisused: The done bucket can only mean Completed — moving a task there marks it done in Vikunja. Remove it from: {{statuses}}.
mapping.completedNotTerminal: Completed does not point at Vikunja's done bucket. Ticking a task off here won't mark it done there, and Vikunja will keep moving finished tasks out of your column.
mapping.confirmCompleted: I understand, sync may fight with Vikunja
mapping.createMissingDescription: This board has no bucket for these statuses. The widget can add them to the kanban view.
mapping.flatNotice: In flat mode In progress / Struggle / Deleted are visible only in the extension; only Completed syncs to Vikunja.
mapping.flatActive: Flat mode is active. The rows above are a suggestion — saving them switches this project to full bucket sync.

summary.title: Vikunja
summary.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Vikunja? Local todos stay, but stop syncing.
summary.switchConfirm: Disconnect Vikunja and pick another integration? Tasks stay in the widget, and a copy of the list is kept in case the next connection goes wrong.
summary.pullPeriodHint: Changes made in Vikunja reach the widget within this interval.
